channel.title: Shift Check: Know Your Pay
channel.description:
Short episodes for hourly and shift workers: keeping your own record of hours, understanding your pay statement, and spotting mistakes early. General information, not legal or tax advice; rules vary by location and employer.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of EarnCheck: Shift & Pay Tracker, an iPhone app to keep your own record of shifts, estimate gross pay and compare it with your pay statement. EarnCheck: Shift & Pay Tracker on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
